Spot emergency files exceptional_end; on-demand non-preemption is buyer case/held money/bond remedy. Foundation records compound payments termination as deferred until hosted bonds and dispute-authority recording are designed.
summary: Final dispute-recorded package supersedes both direct-payment rounds; offline recovery adopts existing seller cases and qualified revised rulings.
